audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer rows read "Pantheon" while content win[] and the packet levelChart read "Akali" on all seven. Every row of the page rendered two opposite answers.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Akali x7, content win[] is Akali x7, and the matchup wins 51.99% over 2262 games. Two sources agree against the full layer's zero.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side = Akali, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and content.mid and wants.foe[2] wrote "Grand Skyfall"; the ability is Grand Starfall.
audit.why: Packet suspectNames flagged it at distance 3, and the kit confirms Grand Starfall (150-180s, 5500 range).
audit.corrected: Corrected in all three places; spikes[1] now keys the reaction to the comet's landing marker.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in the matchup was never stated: Shield Vault is target-locked ("Pantheon dashes to a target"), and Twilight Shroud makes Akali unable to be selected by enemy spells — so the shroud denies his engage outright.
audit.why: The page instead said "respect the all-in any time it is up", which tells the player to fear a spell they can simply delete. Second unstated interaction: Aegis Assault makes him invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT only, so the answer is to get behind him, not to wait him out. It is also a channel, meaning any hard CC cancels it — though Akali brings none herself.
audit.corrected: Smoke before he vaults and he cannot pick you; when Aegis Assault is up, damage him from behind rather than into the shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on either of the two abilities that decide the lane.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s and Aegis Assault is 22-18s; those two windows are the entire trade schedule.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d.

audit.why: Shield Vault carries an auto-attack reset, so the burst arrives on the attack after the dash, not on the dash itself.
audit.corrected: Recorded here; not written to the page because the field that would carry it is already at its length limit with the more important target-lock finding.

edits.after: If Pantheon opens the score, keep the shroud purely for Shield Vault and never farm with it. Two kills: his R roams every 150s, so ping the sides and farm at Q range instead of duelling.

edits.before: Pantheon whiffs Shield Vault (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.

edits.before: Pantheon's Shield Vault stun is scary, but your combo out-damages him in a straight trade once your kit is fully online at 3.
